cases.title: Admin sees Workspace > Webhooks in the sidebar; empty state on a new workspace
Validation: non-http(s) URL is refused with the server message; no events -> "Choose at least one event"; nothing stored
Add endpoint: tick events, save -> secret shown once with Copy; list shows URL, Active and the secret hint; DB row
Send test: banner "Test event delivered", receiver got a signed webhook.test, delivery log lists it and View shows the payload
Edit endpoint: add an event -> chips and DB event_types updated
Rotate secret (confirm) -> a new secret is shown once and differs from the first
Turn off -> badge "Off", DB inactive; turn on again -> Active
Agent: no Webhooks nav entry; /app/webhooks says only admins can manage webhooks; API is 403
Delete (confirm) -> card gone, empty state back, DB endpoint and its deliveries removed
